name: indian-company-drafting
description: Open-source Claude-compatible plugin for drafting Indian company-law tribunal litigation pleadings before the National Company Law Tribunal and the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal. Case-config-aware design — the plugin's structural skeletons are uniform across pleading types, and the parties' chosen forum (NCLT bench / NCLAT Principal or Chennai Bench), share-capital structure, board composition, alleged-oppression-acts, scheme-terms, capital-reduction-arithmetic, strike-off-history, investigation-grounds, operational-debt-particulars, corporate-applicant-financial-distress, and NCLT-order-being-appealed are supplied by the user via a case-config file. Battle-tested workflows for Sections 241/242/244 (oppression and mismanagement), Section 245 (class action), Sections 230-232 (compromise / arrangement / amalgamation / scheme), Section 66 (reduction of share capital), Section 252 (revival of a struck-off company), Section 213 (investigation into the affairs of a company), IBC Section 9 (operational creditor CIRP application), IBC Section 10 (corporate applicant self-initiation), Companies Act Section 421 (appeal to NCLAT from NCLT order), and IBC Section 61 (NCLAT appeal from NCLT order under the IBC). Includes the 6-agent drafting pipeline (Reader -> Format -> Drafter -> Verifier -> Refiner -> Overseer), shared company drafting base with Companies Act 2013 + IBC 2016 + NCLT Rules 2016 + NCLAT Rules 2016 + IBBI Regulations + Secretarial Standards SS-1 / SS-2 + Companies (Compromises, Arrangements and Amalgamations) Rules 2016 + Companies (Inspection, Investigation and Inquiry) Rules 2014 + Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023 + Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 discipline encoded. Companies Act 1956 -> 2013 transition discipline encoded in the Verifier.
